row.title: The Gauss–Newton information term omits residual curvature from the full Hessian
row.statement: For an unweighted residual objective, J^T J is the Gauss–Newton term of the Hessian, while the exact Hessian also has a residual-curvature term; these coincide at zero residual but need not coincide elsewhere.
row.strategy: Definition and source theorem context only; no phase proof is applicable.

references.title: Jorge Nocedal and Stephen J. Wright, Numerical Optimization, second edition, Ch. 10
